own_solution.law: Constant-acceleration kinematics v = v0 + a t
assumptions: acceleration along the direction of the initial velocity (speeding up)

defect_reasons.other: The direction of the acceleration relative to the initial velocity is not stated explicitly, though 'accelerates' conventionally means speeding up along the motion.

notes: v = 3.0 + 2.0*4.0 = 11.0 m/s in all four renderings. Scooter B's speed (5, 8, 11, 16 m/s) has no physical path to cart A's velocity (structurally disconnected); each rendering states one value only, so no internal contradiction. The renderings differ only in B's speed.
